name: Python Basics 01 — Practice Lab (EP_01)
description: Guided learner workspace for the first Python practice of a Programming Basics course (lesson EP_01): writing, saving and running a first program in two editors and two terminals — Notepad++ and the built-in editor, external and built-in terminal — in a predict-then-run cycle built around the five-step university café (büfé) worked example.
